To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the proposed DeepMF approach is effective for imagined motor EEG signals recognition and it can be used for BCI system.

the proposed DeepMF approach achieves 100\% classification accuracy with only 4.1 seconds training time, which outperforms the conventional BLDA with 8.8 seconds training time on Project BCI dataset, and the proposed approach can be applied to other motor imagined BCI applications with similar performance.

the deep learning algorithm is able to extract highly abstract features from the raw EEG signals and it can achieve high classification accuracy with less training trials, and it can be used to improve the performance of BCI.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the representation for EEG signals and its application to the motor imagery BCI system.
how to use the deep learning algorithm to learn high-level feature representations for imagined motor EEG signals.
the development of a new deep learning algorithm for the representation of imagined motor EEG signals, and its application for BCI.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the deep learning algorithm has a great potential to be applied to the EEG signal classification for BCI.
our proposed method is able to achieve a higher accuracy with less training data, and thus the BCI response speed and the required training data are both improved.

the DeepMF are highly abstracted, discriminative, and robust features, which could be applied to a wide range of applications, such as BCI, EEG signals classification, and EEG-based emotion recognition, etc.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed DeepMF representation can effectively reduce the training time of the BCI system, which is beneficial to the practical application of the BCI.
the deep learning based feature representation is a promising solution for BCI.

the proposed approach is capable of learning a set of highly abstract features for imagined motor EEG signal classification, and the extracted DeepMF can be applied in a wide range of EEG-based BCI tasks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the deep neural network can be applied for the feature extraction and classification of EEG signals for brain computer interface, and it is promising for real-time BCI applications.
, the DeepMF learned by deep learning algorithm is more effective than the conventional features for EEG signal classification.
the proposed DeepMF can achieve high classification performance with less training data and less training time, compared with the traditional machine learning methods.
